questions.prompt: Which draw has more raw outs on the flop?

choices.text: A flush draw (9) versus a gutshot (4).
A gutshot versus a flush draw.
One overcard versus a flush draw.
A backdoor draw versus a made flush.

questions.explanation: Nine flush outs is more than four gutshot outs.

choices.text: The flop, with two cards still to come.

questions.explanation: Two cards to come, multiply outs by about four.

choices.text: It is the same color as the felt.
It completes your hand and also completes a better hand for the opponent.

questions.explanation: A dirty out gives you a hand that still loses.

questions.prompt: Seeing both remaining cards is more likely when…

choices.text: You are all-in or the price to continue is small relative to the chance you hit.
You bet huge with no fold equity and no draw.
Stacks are deep and you will fold every turn.

questions.explanation: All-in equity is raw equity. As a favorite to fold later, you realize less.
